purpose: single-dispatch compute-CCL reference walkthrough for sibling all_reduce design

details: RSA single-dispatch topology: 3 cores (0,0) fwd relay, (0,1) bwd relay, (0,2) single reduce core (multi-core reduce deliberately deferred = Refinement 3, never implemented). 2 GlobalSemaphores (sem_fwd/sem_bwd) cached per mesh_device; relay writer issues TWO fabric atomic incs per block on the SAME connection (neighbour relay core + neighbour reduce core) - no local noc fan-out, no multicast. Reduce reader does a two-way non-blocking poll of both sem counters (arrival-major). R1 re-arm: each consumer noc_semaphore_set(own sem,0) after its final wait. 7 kernel descriptors per program, 5 distinct kernel files, 5 CBs.
